meta.title: E×B Probe Velocity Selector
meta.description: Starthermatech provides XHINS-ExB velocity selector probe complete equipment for Hall thruster and plasma source plume diagnostics. Obtains ion velocity and energy distributions, suitable for electric propulsion ground testing and plasma physics research, with equipment ordering and custom solution consulting.
page.title: E×B Probe (Wien Filter)
page.lead: Orthogonal E and B fields transmit only ions at v = E/B, enabling precise ion energy/velocity filtering for plume spectra, IVDF, and impurity analysis.
detail.title: E×B Probe System (XHINS-ExB)
detail.tagline: High-resolution ion velocity/energy diagnostics for Hall thruster and plasma source analysis
detail.overview: The E×B selector passes ions with velocity v = E/B through a collimator. Scanning the electric or magnetic field yields the ion velocity distribution function (IVDF), precisely resolves ion composition (charge-state fractions), determines propellant utilization efficiency, and infers ionization mechanisms—essential for Hall thruster and plasma source performance analysis and optimization.
detail.feature1: Precisely resolve ion velocity distribution function (IVDF) to obtain energy and velocity information
detail.feature2: Separate different charge-state ions (Xe⁺, Xe²⁺, Xe³⁺, etc.) and accurately measure composition ratios
detail.feature3: Determine propellant utilization efficiency through charge-state distribution to evaluate thruster performance
detail.feature4: Infer ionization mechanisms from multi-charge-state data to support discharge mode optimization and physics research
